Message:
bpf: Use KF_FASTCALL to mark kfuncs supporting fastcall contract

In order to allow pahole add btf_decl_tag("bpf_fastcall") for kfuncs
supporting bpf_fastcall, mark such functions with KF_FASTCALL in
id_set8 objects.
